alex: Heads-up — proposing a cut window for v2.3 on Wed Apr 12. Need a short go/no-go sync to confirm canaries, DB migration plan, and rollback readiness. Can everyone RSVP and tag smoke owners? Proposed agenda below.

sana: ✅ I can attend. Small ask — could we nudge it to 17:00 UTC? I have a conflict at 16:00.

alex: 17:00 UTC works for me. I'll update the calendar once we get a couple more thumbs. Poll: https://poll.service/abc123 — please mark avail.

mike: I'm out at 17:00 but available until 16:30. I can lead the canary smoke if it's earlier.

tara: I can own DB migration checklist + rollback runbook. Will attach a short doc before EOD.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window (tentative): 2033-04-12T16:00Z. Reminder will be posted 48h before.

jen: Quick check — are all CRs merged into the release branch? cc @luis

luis: Last CR (perf/kv-cache) is in review, aiming to merge EOD today. Will post CI link when green.

alex: Draft agenda (concise):
1) Roll status — merged CRs & failing tests
2) Canary smoke owner + smoke checklist
3) DB migration plan + rollback verification
4) Contingency: routing/profile toggle & fallback model
5) Post-cut verification steps & ownership

sana: Can we add an item: validate routing policy toggle? That caused flakiness in previous cut.

tara: Good call. I'll add 'routing toggle validation' under contingency. mike — you ok to own canary smoke? @mike

mike: Yep, I'll take canary smoke. I'll prepare the smoke script and perf pass/fail thresholds.

alex: Please drop any late-breaking blockers here by EOD. If none, agenda locks at 09:00 UTC tomorrow and I'll send the invite.

infra-bot: Calendar draft created: https://cal.service/meet/xyz — will update time once poll closes.

jen: tagging security for telemetry concerns during cut — @security can you confirm telemetry mute plan?

security: We'll need to confirm PII scrub rules and mute levels for canary telemetry. I'll post an approval note by EOD with the required config lines.

alex: Final rollcall for the sync: alex, sana, mike, tara, luis, jen, security. If you're listed but can't make it, flag now so we can assign backups.

sana: here — confirmed for 17:00

luis: here

mike: here (canary owner)

tara: here (DB + rollback)

security: here — will upload sign-off doc in this thread by EOD.

alex: Thanks everyone. If anyone has a short prereq (small test build, smoke checklist items), paste them here so we can triage before the sync.
